description: Defines a Rectangle class with geometric operations such as combine, intersection, overlaps, and containment checks within the WPEFramework::Core namespace.

classes.name: Rectangle
classes.description: Represents a rectangle with position (x, y) and size (w, h), providing methods for comparison, combination, intersection, overlap detection, and containment.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks if two rectangles are equal based on their position and size.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Checks if two rectangles are not equal.

methods.name: combine
methods.description: Expands the rectangle to enclose both this and another rectangle.

methods.name: operator&
methods.description: Returns the intersection of this rectangle with another.

methods.name: Overlaps
methods.description: Determines if this rectangle overlaps with another.

methods.name: operator|
methods.description: Returns the minimal rectangle that contains both this and another rectangle.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Checks if a point (tx, ty) lies within the rectangle.
